definitions.gloss: desire for career advancement; ambition (for success); drive to get ahead
definitions.explanation: A strong personal desire to rise in rank, status, or position — especially at a company or in society. Has a mildly negative or neutral nuance; "ambition" in a pure, positive sense is more often expressed with {向上心|こうじょうしん}.

examples.japanese: {出世欲|しゅっせよく}が{強|つよ}い。
examples.english: To have a strong desire for success.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}にはあまり{出世欲|しゅっせよく}がないらしい。
examples.english: He apparently doesn't have much desire to climb the career ladder.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いうちは{出世欲|しゅっせよく}に{燃|も}えていたが、{今|いま}は{家族|かぞく}との{時間|じかん}を{大切|たいせつ}にしている。
examples.english: When I was young I burned with ambition, but now I value time with my family.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{若手|わかて}{社員|しゃいん}は、{昔|むかし}に{比|くら}べて{出世欲|しゅっせよく}が{薄|うす}いと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that compared to the past, today's young employees have weaker ambitions for advancement.

notes:
Composed of {出世|しゅっせ} (rising in the world, career success) and {欲|よく} (desire, drive). Refers to the desire to rise through the ranks of a company or of society — to get promoted, gain status, and earn a higher position.

REGISTER & NUANCE:
The word can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context. Someone described as having strong {出世欲|しゅっせよく} may be admired for their drive, but can also be seen as overly competitive or self-interested. For a more consistently positive term meaning general self-improvement ambition, use {向上心|こうじょうしん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出世欲|しゅっせよく}が{強|つよ}い: to have strong ambition
- {出世欲|しゅっせよく}がない: to have no ambition for advancement
- {出世欲|しゅっせよく}に{燃|も}える: to burn with ambition
- {出世欲|しゅっせよく}の{塊|かたまり}: a mass of ambition (a very ambitious person)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}: desire for self-improvement — always positive; broader than career ambition
- {野心|やしん}: ambition (often bold or ruthless) — a stronger word; may suggest scheming
- {功名心|こうみょうしん}: desire for fame or achievement — emphasizes wanting to be recognized
- {上昇志向|じょうしょうしこう}: upward-striving orientation — a more analytical, sociological term for the same drive
